name: paper-polisher-pro
description: AI writing detector (author self-check) + academic polishing guidance + terminology protection, 100% local. 11-layer recalibrated rule engine + token-spectrum layer + length-routed fusion + optional supervised Qwen3-0.6B ONNX layer (AUROC 1.0 held-out) + LLM fingerprint attribution (GLM/DeepSeek/Qwen/Kimi/MiniMax/GPT/Claude/Gemini) + journal precheck + AIGC compliance label check + paragraph attribution + sentence-level rewrite suggestions (guidance, never auto-rewrite). Eval-driven: base-engine numbers reproduce via the bundled held-out evaluation; supervised-layer figures are author-side held-out measurements.
author: DoctorQ Lab
changelog: v7.1.0: custom terminology banks (--bank) — term_check and pp_term_consistency accept a project bank (JSON array, same format as the built-in bank: cn/en/aliases/source) merged over the built-in entries (same-cn override); thesis-specific abbreviations and institution names unify through the project bank; entries validated with line numbers (bad entries are reported, never silently dropped). Consistency: SKILL.md title version fossil (still "v3" at 7.0.0) removed with a gate; README AUROC aligned to the fingerprint-bound 0.9998 caliber with a gate. No engine scoring changes. 零新增依赖。
